'''''Consolea''''' is a [[genus]] of [[cactus]], named after [[Italy|Italian]] [[botanist]] [[Michelangelo Console]]. Members of the genus are native to the [[West Indies]] and [[Florida]] in the [[United States]]. Members of this genus consist of trees up to 10 m in height; they are [[dioecious]] or subdioecious.<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1002/ajb2.1610|title=Pleistocene aridification underlies the evolutionary history of the Caribbean endemic, insular, giant ''Consolea'' (Opuntioideae)|year=2021|last1=Majure|first1=Lucas C.|last2=Barrios|first2=Duniel|last3=Díaz|first3=Edgardo|last4=Zumwalde|first4=Bethany A.|last5=Testo|first5=Weston|last6=Negrón-Ortíz|first6=Vivian|journal=American Journal of Botany|volume=108|issue=2|pages=200–215|pmid=33598914|s2cid=231953784 |doi-access=free}}</ref>
